title: Before Meaning, Before Choice: A Readout-Native Derivation of Experience, Live Possibility, Agency, and Human-AI Return

equations.section: 2.5 Power, interpretive resources, and structural deprivation (intro to Readout constitution)
equations.text: Retention -> Structure -> Translation -> Readout -> Meaning -> Report
equations.meaning: The most compressed form of the readout-native admission order for semantic categories.

equations.section: 2.5 Power, interpretive resources, and structural deprivation (intro to Readout constitution)
equations.text: Retention -> Structure -> Candidate State -> Sufficiency -> Quotient -> Domain Dynamics -> Readout -> Meaning -> Experience -> Memory -> Knowledge -> Checked Report
equations.meaning: The stronger MEMK extension of the compressed admission order; the MEMK specification's own mandatory order reads Retention->Structure->Translation->Meaning->Report.

equations.section: 3.1 Root state and finite stepper
equations.meaning: Non-semantic retained root state: a retained relational carrier, retained labels/typed distinctions, and an append-only tape of lineage/residues/deviations.

equations.section: 3.1 Root state and finite stepper
equations.meaning: The root transition interface.

equations.section: 3.1 Root state and finite stepper
equations.meaning: Critical separation: retained root state, candidate semantic-cognitive representation, and discovered domain quotient are different objects.

equations.section: 4. Domain Weld: How Human Vocabulary Is Admitted
equations.text: q_(D,n+1) o F_n = F^#_(D,n) o q_(D,n)
equations.meaning: Schematic domain-weld condition governing whether a domain-level statement may be emitted at all; structurally analogous to abstraction/homomorphism but epistemic as well as mathematical.

equations.section: 4. Domain Weld: How Human Vocabulary Is Admitted
equations.text: epsilon_H = Def( q~_H o F, F^#_H o q~_H, O_H, Inv_H )
equations.meaning: Declared defect vector for a candidate human-domain translation, together with a preregistered acceptance rule ||epsilon_H|| <= tau_H if a quantitative gate is attempted.

equations.section: 5. From Retained Record to Meaning and Experience
equations.meaning: MEMK's non-collapse between event occurrence, retained event record before semantic naming, and MEMK-accessible trace.

equations.section: 5. From Retained Record to Meaning and Experience
equations.meaning: A finite human readout of the accessible trace, conditioned on current human-domain state, context, and active question/criterion.

equations.section: 5. From Retained Record to Meaning and Experience
equations.meaning: Meaning as a significance relation, not a substance carried inside x_n.

equations.section: 5. From Retained Record to Meaning and Experience
equations.meaning: Analytic decomposition of meaning into affective, pragmatic, autobiographical, conceptual, and epistemic modes, not treated as biological modules.

equations.section: 5. From Retained Record to Meaning and Experience
equations.meaning: Experience as a configuration of trace, meaning, and the effective strength/control of active meaning over the current experience, under context.

equations.section: 5. From Retained Record to Meaning and Experience
equations.meaning: Conceptual compression of the experience definition; not a claim that the reader makes the phenomenon true.

equations.section: 5.1 Naming comes later, but can loop back
equations.text: l_n = L_H(E_n, mu_n | H_n, c_n);  E_n, mu_n may precede stable l_n
equations.meaning: Meaning Before Naming: lived significance can precede stable lexical articulation.

equations.section: 5.1 Naming comes later, but can loop back
equations.meaning: Correction of a one-way reading: naming can reorganise what it articulates, feeding back into subsequent meaning and experience.

equations.section: 6. Retention: The Reader Can Change
equations.text: H_(n+1) = U_H( H_n, Retain(E_n, mu_n, rho^H_n), delta^world_(n:n+1), X^other_(n:n+1) )
equations.meaning: Generic dependency form for selective cross-time persistence: only selected residues carry forward, co-determined with world correction and other experience.

equations.section: 6. Retention: The Reader Can Change
equations.meaning: Central temporal asymmetry: a non-zero retained residue makes a different effective interpretive operator for the next situation possible but not guaranteed.

equations.section: 7. History-Shaped Readout-Accessibility
equations.meaning: Semantic attraction: destination-sensitive access-landscape gradient, not a physical potential.

equations.section: 7. History-Shaped Readout-Accessibility
equations.meaning: Recent-path momentum: a path-sensitive history descriptor, kept separate from destination-sensitive attraction.

equations.section: 7. History-Shaped Readout-Accessibility
equations.text: kappa^sem_(t+1)(e|Q) proportional-to kappa^sem_t(e|Q) * exp[ beta a_(Q,t)(e) + mu_m m_t(e) - nu c_(A,t,Q)(e) + xi_t(e) ]
equations.meaning: Candidate history-shaped access law combining structural availability, attraction, recent traversal, and control cost; explicitly marked Open as a typed finite hypothesis, not a validated universal cognitive law.

equations.section: 7. History-Shaped Readout-Accessibility / 8. Before Choice: The Live Possibility Field
equations.meaning: Nesting of physically possible, structurally feasible, and currently live policies for task g.

equations.section: 8. Before Choice: The Live Possibility Field
equations.meaning: Practical accessibility profile over the feasible policy set.

equations.section: 8. Before Choice: The Live Possibility Field
equations.meaning: The current live set defined by an operational, study-specific threshold; the threshold is a measurement device, not a universal psychological constant.

equations.section: 8. Before Choice: The Live Possibility Field
equations.meaning: Overt choice is downstream: selected only from the live possibility set.

equations.section: 8. Before Choice: The Live Possibility Field
equations.text: pi^act_(A,t) != pi^choice_(A,t) is possible;  Y_obs = O_q(H_(0:T)),  Y_obs != H_(0:T)
equations.meaning: Enactment may diverge from the chosen policy, and evaluator-visible records need not reveal the underlying trajectory.

equations.section: 8. Before Choice: The Live Possibility Field
equations.text: possible != feasible != live != chosen != enacted != observed
equations.meaning: The non-collapse chain sharpening the claim 'choice begins before choice': the architecture of deliberative choice has ancestral conditions in retention, discrimination, translation, and history-shaped accessibility.

equations.section: 9. Effective, Corrigible Agency
equations.text: p*_(A,g)(h,z;T,B,P) = max_(pi in Pi^wit_A(g;h,z,T,B)) Pr^(pi_P)( Read_g cap D_g cap X_g cap F_g )
equations.meaning: Task-specific effective-agency potential read over the witnessed option set: the finite set of policies for which a retained record exists that a comparable agent executed within horizon T and budget B; the unread remainder is a non-readout, not a smaller number waiting to be found.

equations.section: 9.1 Power before prohibition
equations.text: Power may alter agency by altering meaning/accessibility before overt choice
equations.meaning: Narrower political thesis following from explicit live accessibility: social/institutional conditions can change whether refusal, appeal, delay, exit, or negotiation becomes practically live before any direct prohibition.

equations.section: 10. Human-AI Mediation Begins Before the Prompt
equations.meaning: A prompt is a bounded articulation of the human state, not the whole human state; the prompt is a readout of a readout.

equations.section: 10. Human-AI Mediation Begins Before the Prompt
equations.meaning: The AI receives the prompt and returns output Y_t.

equations.section: 10. Human-AI Mediation Begins Before the Prompt
equations.meaning: Candidate contract: AI output is knowledge-like, not certified knowledge; fluency, citations, or formal appearance do not upgrade status by themselves.

equations.section: 10. Human-AI Mediation Begins Before the Prompt
equations.meaning: AI output re-enters the human domain as another mediated encounter.

equations.section: 10. Human-AI Mediation Begins Before the Prompt
equations.text: H_(t+1) = U_H( H_t, E^AI_(H,t), delta^world, X^other )
equations.meaning: Update of the human state after the mediated AI encounter, folding in world correction and other experience.

equations.section: 10. Human-AI Mediation Begins Before the Prompt
equations.meaning: If a residue is retained, the accessibility profile before the next prompt may differ from the previous one; external evidence (Glickman and Sharot) supports the general history-sensitivity claim.

equations.section: 10.1 Difference, resistance, and retained human agency
equations.meaning: Three non-substitutable constitutive necessities (Difference, Resistance, retained human Agency) for durable human epistemic expansion under Fusion/Tunnel's stipulated target.

equations.section: 10.1 Difference, resistance, and retained human agency
equations.text: Delta Omega^(fH)_s = B_s A_s,  rank(B_s A_s) << d_H
equations.meaning: Programme-notation proposal (Master River audit) for a low-rank candidate update, functionally analogous to LoRA but not a claim that brains implement engineering LoRA.

equations.section: 10.1 Difference, resistance, and retained human agency
equations.text: Omega^H_(s+1,0) = Omega^H_(s,0) + eta_s Delta Omega^(fH)_s,  0 <= eta_s <= 1
equations.meaning: Retention-gate update separated from the candidate update (36); the audit's proposal for writing Fusion/Tunnel's intent without a doubled gate.

equations.section: 11. Human Return: The Upper Measurement Boundary
equations.text: H^return = < G_CTSA, L, M, P, W, Delta_dir >
equations.meaning: Compact Human Return record: demonstrated gain, loss, metacognitive regulation, provenance, warrant/effective resistance, and epistemic direction; bookkeeping architecture, not a universal scalar.

equations.section: 11. Human Return: The Upper Measurement Boundary
equations.meaning: Non-collapse law: a persistent misconception is still persistent; CTSA records it without granting knowledge status.

equations.section: 11. Human Return: The Upper Measurement Boundary
equations.meaning: Non-collapse law: gross gain cannot define net human expansion.

equations.section: 13. Provenance and Claim Status Are Part of the Equation
equations.text: Lambda(e_i) = < Prov_i, Tier_i, Def_i, Reader_i, Falsifier_i >
equations.meaning: A ledger attached to each transition e_i in the river, recording provenance, claim tier, defects, reader, and falsifier; the river is not fully specified without this ledger.

equations.section: 14. Why This Is Not Simply Active Inference
equations.text: root retention =/=|= belief state =/=|= meaning =/=|= experience =/=|= choice
equations.meaning: The distinction from active inference is one of derivation order and epistemic governance, not richer dynamics: root retention must not be identified with belief state, meaning, experience, or choice.

equations.section: 15. Why This Is Not Simply Affordance or Capability Theory
equations.text: feasible for the agent != currently live for the agent
equations.meaning: The residual difference the Live Possibility Field must capture beyond affordance theory and the capability approach.

equations.section: 18. Graceful Degradation
equations.text: retained distinction -> domain translation/readout -> meaning -> experience -> retained change -> graded accessibility -> live possibility -> choice/action -> feedback/new record
equations.meaning: The load-bearing core chain that survives deletion of the programme's more provocative metaphors (Human LoRA, resonance, rhythm, barrier language, CTSA's four-class taxonomy).

equations.section: 20. Conclusion: Before Meaning, Before Choice
equations.text: Retained Difference -> Admissible Readout -> Meaning -> Experience -> History-Shaped Accessibility -> Live Possibility -> Choice -> Corrigible Agency -> World Consequence -> New Retained Difference
equations.meaning: The paper's final restated derivational-constraint river, from retained difference to a new retained difference.

equations.label: H1
equations.section: 17.2 Minimal empirical predictions
equations.text: H1 - Live-field incremental value [Open]. Under matched feasible sets, L_(A,t) will explain reproducible variance in which alternatives enter spontaneous practical consideration beyond resources, preference ratings, and ordinary salience measures.
equations.meaning: Minimal empirical prediction testing the incremental value of the live-field accessibility profile.

equations.label: H2
equations.section: 17.2 Minimal empirical predictions
equations.text: H2 - History residual [Open]. Prior traversal history will predict later route accessibility after current semantic state, task, and control variables are matched. Failure removes the distinct momentum term.
equations.meaning: Minimal empirical prediction testing the history-momentum term (19)-(20).

equations.label: H3
equations.section: 17.2 Minimal empirical predictions
equations.text: H3 - Pre-prompt carryover [externally constrained, mechanism Open]. Repeated Human-AI interaction can alter later human judgements before a new AI response is seen.
equations.meaning: Minimal empirical prediction on carryover from prior AI interaction into later judgement, externally supported by Glickman and Sharot but with the readout-native mechanism left open.

equations.label: H4
equations.section: 17.2 Minimal empirical predictions
equations.text: H4 - Human Return dissociation [Open]. Delayed unaided Concept, Tool, Skill, and Alternative Return will show partially dissociable profiles rather than collapse into one generic performance factor.
equations.meaning: Minimal empirical prediction testing dissociation among the four CTSA Human Return classes.

equations.label: H5
equations.section: 17.2 Minimal empirical predictions
equations.text: H5 - Gain/loss asymmetry [Open]. Positive gross return can coexist with reduced checking habits, uncertainty sensitivity, or alternative accessibility; net human expansion will therefore differ from gross retained gain.
equations.meaning: Minimal empirical prediction testing gain/loss asymmetry within Human Return.

equations.label: H6
equations.section: 17.2 Minimal empirical predictions
equations.text: H6 - Optional modifiers must earn survival [Open]. Resonance, rhythm, and barrier/transition variables remain only if they add held-out explanatory or predictive value beyond schema, familiarity, appraisal, retrieval, exposure count, event boundaries, and continuous accumulation models.
equations.meaning: Minimal empirical prediction/removal condition for the optional resonance/rhythm/barrier modifiers.
